task.title: Course catalog from the server
task.html: Course catalog
task.description: The page has a button #reload-btn, a paragraph #courses-status and an empty list #course-list. The server at "data/courses.json" returns an array of courses like { title: "HTML", lessons: 10 } (in the IDE the server is replaced with test data; write the code as for a real one). Write the function loadCourses(): 1) Loading: clear #course-list, write the text "Loading..." into #courses-status, remove the class is-error from it and disable #reload-btn (.prop("disabled", true)). 2) Call $.getJSON("data/courses.json") and handle the result with .done, .fail and .always (not with await). 3) In .done, save the array in localStorage under the key courses with JSON.stringify; if the array is empty, the status is "No courses yet"; otherwise the status is an empty string, and for each course add to the list an li with the class course and the text "HTML - lessons: 10", created with $("<li>") and .text(). 4) In .fail: the status "Could not load the courses" and the class is-error. 5) In .always, enable the button. 6) Call loadCourses() once at startup and connect it to clicks on #reload-btn with .on(). Do not use document.querySelector, innerHTML, .html(), fetch or await.

questions.question: What does $.getJSON("data/courses.json") return right after the call?
options: A jqXHR object - a request whose response will come later
undefined until there is a response
questions.explanation: The request is asynchronous: a jqXHR (a "tracking number") is returned right away, and the data comes later in .done.
The function from .done is called when the server response arrives - after the rest of the code has run.

questions.question: Match the method with the moment it is called.
pairs: In any case, after it finishes
Waits for the result inside an async function
questions.explanation: done is success, fail is error, always is always; await works with jqXHR because it has .then.

questions.question: In which situations will .fail of $.getJSON fire?
options: The file contains JSON with a comma after the last item
The page is opened via file://
The server returned an empty array []
questions.explanation: 404 and file:// (status 0) are request errors, broken JSON is a parsererror. An empty array is a successful response; it is handled in .done.

questions.question: Where is the right place to enable the "Refresh" button after a request?
questions.explanation: .always fires both on success and on error - the button will not stay disabled.

questions.question: Which jqXHR property contains the server response code (for example, 404)? Enter the property name.
questions.explanation: jqXHR.status is a number: 200, 404, 500, or 0 if there was no response.

options: courses holds a jqXHR, not an array: the data is available only in .done or after await
You cannot name a variable courses
You need to call JSON.parse first
questions.explanation: $.getJSON returns a jqXHR. Code that needs the data is written in .done((courses) => {...}).

questions.question: What is true about await with a jQuery request?
options: const data = await $.getJSON(url) puts the parsed data into data
On error, catch receives a jqXHR with the property status
You can write await in any function
await works with jqXHR because it has a .then method
questions.explanation: jqXHR is a "thenable", so you can wait for it. But await is allowed only inside an async function.

questions.question: Match the code with its purpose.
pairs: Send the form fields to the server
A request with settings, without the cache
The full address the response came from (jQuery 4.1)
questions.explanation: $.getJSON and $.post are short forms, $.ajax is the full configuration. responseURL was added in 4.1.

questions.question: You opened index.html with a double click, and $.getJSON goes to .fail with status 0. What should you do?
options: Open the page with Live Server (http://127.0.0.1:5500)
questions.explanation: The browser does not allow pages on file:// to load files. You need an http address - Live Server or GitHub Pages.

questions.question: How do you correctly save the array courses in localStorage?
questions.explanation: localStorage stores only strings. Without JSON.stringify the array turns into the string "[object Object],...".

questions.question: Which $.ajax setting must be set to false so that the browser does not return an old copy of the response? Enter the setting name.
questions.explanation: With cache: false, jQuery adds the parameter _= with the current time to the address, and the browser asks the server again.
